prompt:
Build me something when people see it, they will say "Wow". Must be immersive, when people see it, they will be stunned by what they see.

This can be a video, or anything else you can think of.

Be creative. Go wild. Dig deep.

No AI slop. Something unique, think outside of the box. Think big. Think amazing. Something no other model done before.

Be proud. Show your best. Don't disappoint.

post.originalText:
Built by Opus 5.5 (Ultracode)

Created by its own creativity.

No images, no video, no audio files. Every frame and every note is generated by code, live, from the word you type.

Live here: https://t.co/X6PVr6gQjZ

How it works and the full prompt below. https://t.co/FgEcVrFb9u

sourceMaterials.text:
Full prompt:

Build me something when people see it, they will say "Wow". Must be immersive, when people see it, they will be stunned by what they see.

This can be a video, or anything else you can think of.

Be creative. Go wild. Dig deep.

No AI slop. Something unique, think outside of the box. Think big. Think amazing. Something no other model done before.

Be proud. Show your best. Don't disappoint.
sourceMaterials.author: MiaAI_lab

sourceMaterials.text:
How this works:

- The word is the seed. Your word becomes a number, and that number decides everything: the music's key and melody, the shapes of the stars, galaxy and planet, and when things happen. The same word always gives the same universe.

- The graphics are pure math. Small GPU programs (shaders) compute every pixel 60+ times a second, and nothing is loaded from files. A post-processing pass then adds bloom, glow, grain and film-like color.

- The music is synthesized live. The browser's Web Audio API plays synthesizers, bells and impacts in real time, with no audio files, all synced to the picture.
